t: This is Wood Street, a street in the City of London, the historic centre and financial district. It begins in the south at Cheapside, then runs north across Gresham Street and London Wall, ending beside The Postern, part of the Barbican estate, at Andrewes House. Today it sits in the wards of Bassishaw and Cheap. One person tied to the street is Susannah Millner, who lived here at the sign of the Red Lion. She acted as a communication intermediary among the Society of Friends, the Quakers, so this was a point where their messages passed through.
